achv.growth-spurt.name: Growth Spurt
achv.growth-spurt.desc: Reach levels 10, 25 and 50. Each one costs more soup than the last.
achv.triple-digits.name: Triple Digits, Eventually
achv.triple-digits.desc: Reach levels 75, 100 and 125. The tailor now knows your measurements by heart.
achv.fold-marks.name: Fold Marks
achv.fold-marks.desc: Unlock 3, 6 and finally all 10 zones. The map has strong opinions about being folded.
achv.chapter-and-verse.name: Chapter and Verse
achv.chapter-and-verse.desc: Reach chapters 2, 5 and 8 of the Ballad. The bard is taking notes. Badly, but taking them.
achv.known-at-the-door.name: Known at the Door
achv.known-at-the-door.desc: Play on 7, 30 and 100 separate days. Eventually the innkeeper stops asking your name.
achv.year-of-mud.name: A Year of Mud
achv.year-of-mud.desc: Show up on 365 different days. Same boots, mostly.
achv.errand-economy.name: Errand Economy
achv.errand-economy.desc: Complete 25, 250 and 1,000 quests. Brambleford runs on favours and hastily written receipts.
achv.hinge-whisperer.name: Hinge Whisperer
achv.hinge-whisperer.desc: Open 10, 50 and 200 daily chests. The hinges have learned your grip.
achv.nothing-left-in-the-tank.name: Nothing Left in the Tank
achv.nothing-left-in-the-tank.desc: Spend 2,000, 50,000 and 500,000 vigor. Sleep is a reward like any other.
achv.creature-of-habit.name: Creature of Habit
achv.creature-of-habit.desc: Spin the wheel 30, 180 and 365 times. Destiny appreciates punctuality.
achv.coin-return.name: Coin Return
achv.coin-return.desc: Toss 25, 250 and 1,000 coins into the wishing well. The well does not give change.
achv.shelf-life.name: Shelf Life
achv.shelf-life.desc: Claim 20, 60 and 120 achievement tiers. Yes, this one counts itself. It is that sort of shelf.
achv.regular-in-the-sand.name: Regular in the Sand
achv.regular-in-the-sand.desc: Win 10, 100 and 1,000 arena bouts. Somebody has to rake it afterwards either way.
achv.signed-the-waiver.name: Signed the Waiver
achv.signed-the-waiver.desc: Enter 50, 500 and 5,000 arena bouts. Turning up is its own discipline.
achv.on-a-tear.name: On a Tear
achv.on-a-tear.desc: Win 5, then 10 arena bouts in a row without a single unfortunate afternoon.
achv.seam-finder.name: Seam Finder
achv.seam-finder.desc: Land 100, 1,000 and 10,000 critical hits. All armour has seams. Most smiths deny it.
achv.shield-first.name: Shield First
achv.immovable-object.name: The Immovable Object
achv.immovable-object.desc: Block 2,500 and then 10,000 blows. Your shield has a dent for every one of them.
achv.elsewhere-professionally.name: Elsewhere, Professionally
achv.elsewhere-professionally.desc: Evade 500 attacks by the simple method of not being there.
achv.rumour-of-a-person.name: Rumour of a Person
achv.rumour-of-a-person.desc: Evade 2,500 and then 10,000 attacks. Witnesses now disagree on whether you attended.
achv.stairwell-enthusiast.name: Stairwell Enthusiast
achv.stairwell-enthusiast.desc: Clear 5, 25 and 50 dungeon floors. Mind the fourth stair; it minds you.
achv.basement-cartographer.name: Basement Cartographer
achv.basement-cartographer.desc: Clear 100, 250 and 500 dungeon floors. You know which torches lie.
achv.the-long-tally.name: The Long Tally
achv.the-long-tally.desc: Slay 250, 5,000 and 50,000 monsters. The ledger has needed its own ledger for some time.
achv.not-a-scratch.name: Not a Scratch
achv.not-a-scratch.desc: Beat a floor boss without losing a single exchange. Take the applause; you earned the silence too.
achv.one-point-of-dignity.name: One Point of Dignity
achv.one-point-of-dignity.desc: Win a fight with under 5% health left. Style points, awarded grudgingly, by a healer.
achv.statistically-concerning.name: Statistically Concerning
achv.statistically-concerning.desc: Win 5 and then 25 fights from under 5% health. The infirmary would like a word.
achv.started-a-filing-system.name: Started a Filing System
achv.started-a-filing-system.desc: Complete 10% and then 50% of the codex. Somebody has to write all this down.
achv.every-last-page.name: Every Last Page
achv.every-last-page.desc: Complete 100% of the codex. Nothing left to discover, which is its own quiet problem.
achv.know-thy-neighbour.name: Know Thy Neighbour
achv.know-thy-neighbour.desc: Fill 25%, 60% and 100% of the bestiary. Names first, opinions afterwards.
achv.catalogued-and-judged.name: Catalogued and Judged
achv.catalogued-and-judged.desc: Discover 25%, 60% and 100% of the armory's designs, including the hats you would never wear.
achv.marginalia.name: Marginalia
achv.marginalia.desc: Unlock 10 and then 40 codex lore entries. Ten introductions per monster, apparently.
achv.small-committee.name: A Small Committee
achv.small-committee.desc: Adopt 4, 10 and all 16 companions. The feeding schedule is sold separately.
achv.fewer-problems.name: Four Legs, Fewer Problems
achv.fewer-problems.desc: Raise your stable to tiers 2, 3 and 4. The saddle is finally the comfortable part.
achv.matching-finally.name: Matching, Finally
achv.matching-finally.desc: Complete 1, 5 and all 14 item sets. Coordination is a martial art nobody teaches.
achv.nearly-a-set.name: Nearly a Set
achv.nearly-a-set.desc: Find 10, 60 and 300 set pieces. The last one is always a boot.
achv.named-things.name: Named Things
achv.named-things.desc: Own 1, 4 and all 8 legendary uniques. They introduce themselves in the third person.
achv.lightning-repeatedly.name: Lightning, Repeatedly
achv.lightning-repeatedly.desc: Find 1, 5 and 20 legendaries out in the world. Statistically rude.
achv.framed.name: Framed
achv.framed.desc: Collect 3 and then all 12 portrait frames. The portrait is unchanged; the frame is everything.
achv.gold-fever.name: Gold Fever
achv.gold-fever.desc: Earn 100,000, then 10 million, then a billion gold. The pouch has structural concerns.
achv.money-moves-out.name: Money Moves, Mostly Outward
achv.money-moves-out.desc: Spend 100,000, 10 million and a billion gold. Circulation is a public service.
achv.self-improvement-budget.name: Self-Improvement Budget
achv.self-improvement-budget.desc: Buy 100, 1,000 and 5,000 attribute points. Personal growth, by invoice.
achv.one-expensive-pushup.name: One Very Expensive Push-Up
achv.one-expensive-pushup.desc: Spend 10 million gold on a single attribute point. Briefly, it felt worth it.
achv.anvils-favourite.name: The Anvil's Favourite
achv.anvils-favourite.desc: Forge one item all the way to +20. The smith has stopped charging for the small talk.
achv.ring-ring-ring.name: Ring, Ring, Ring
achv.ring-ring-ring.desc: Land 25, 250 and 1,000 forge upgrades. The neighbours have been notified.
achv.regret-recycled.name: Regret, Recycled
achv.regret-recycled.desc: Dismantle 100 and then 1,000 items. Everything is scrap if you are brave enough about it.
achv.vendors-best-friend.name: The Vendor's Best Friend
achv.vendors-best-friend.desc: Sell 100, 1,000 and 10,000 items. He long ago stopped asking where they came from.
achv.just-browsing.name: Just Browsing
achv.just-browsing.desc: Buy 50 and then 500 things from the shops. Browsing, allegedly.
achv.you-sold-what.name: You Sold It
achv.you-sold-what.desc: Sell a legendary unique. It seemed like a perfectly reasonable idea at the time.
achv.boots-on-the-board.name: Boots on the Board
achv.boots-on-the-board.desc: Complete 50, 500 and 2,500 missions. The board never runs out; that was always the deal.
achv.ten-thousand-errands.name: Ten Thousand Errands
achv.ten-thousand-errands.desc: Complete 10,000 missions. Somewhere out there, a hedge is grateful.
achv.out-of-office.name: Out of Office
achv.out-of-office.desc: Finish 10 and then 100 expeditions. Pack light, come back heavy.
achv.professional-elsewhere.name: Professionally Elsewhere
achv.professional-elsewhere.desc: Finish 500 expeditions. The road has a favourite now and is not subtle about it.
achv.gilded-latch.name: The Gilded Latch
achv.gilded-latch.desc: Open 10 and then 100 gold-tier expedition chests. Heroism pays, occasionally, in metal.
achv.choose-wisely-repeatedly.name: Choose Wisely, Repeatedly
achv.choose-wisely-repeatedly.desc: Resolve 50, 500 and 2,500 expedition cards. Two doors, one of you, endless afternoons.
achv.all-four-corners.name: All Four Corners
achv.all-four-corners.desc: Set foot in every expedition locale. Yes, including the damp one.
achv.first-full-round.name: First Full Round
achv.first-full-round.desc: Bank 48 patrol ticks: a full day of honest pacing, lantern included.
achv.night-shift.name: The Night Shift
achv.night-shift.desc: Patrol for 100 and then 1,000 hours. The lanterns recognise your footsteps.
achv.local-expert.name: Local Expert
achv.local-expert.desc: Discover every monster in a single zone. You could give tours of it. Some would even be accurate.
achv.the-wheel-is-honest.name: The Wheel Is Honest
achv.the-wheel-is-honest.desc: Land the wheel's jackpot. It does happen. It happened to you.
achv.owed-and-paid.name: Owed and Paid
achv.owed-and-paid.desc: Reach the well's pity limit and collect your set piece. The well settles every debt eventually.
achv.twenty-five-straight.name: Twenty-Five Straight
achv.twenty-five-straight.desc: Win 25 arena bouts in a row. Nobody has ended a run of yours in weeks.
achv.punching-upward.name: Punching Upward
achv.punching-upward.desc: Beat a boss at least 10 levels above you. Rude, effective and entirely within the rules.
achv.fully-medicated.name: Fully Medicated
achv.fully-medicated.desc: Drink 21 elixirs: three rack slots kept full for a solid week. Purely medicinal.
achv.ten-of-ten-thirty-times.name: Ten of Ten, Thirty Times
achv.ten-of-ten-thirty-times.desc: Use all ten rewarded bouts on 30 separate days. The sand has never had a more punctual guest.
achv.twenty-eight-for-twenty-eight.name: Twenty-Eight for Twenty-Eight
achv.twenty-eight-for-twenty-eight.desc: Claim all 28 calendar days in a month. Not one forgotten Tuesday.
achv.meter-pegged.name: Meter Pegged
achv.meter-pegged.desc: Fill the activity meter to 100 on 100 days. Consistency: the least dramatic kind of heroism.
achv.fifty-wishes.name: Fifty Wishes
achv.fifty-wishes.desc: Click the wishing well 50 times without tossing anything in. The well noticed. It is flattered.
achv.rematch-denied.name: The Rematch
achv.rematch-denied.desc: Take Krellbor up on the rematch he keeps promising. Discover he practised. Lose with excellent grace.
achv.the-cat-decides.name: The Cat Decides
achv.the-cat-decides.desc: Pet the innkeeper's cat on 30 separate days. It has still not decided about you.
achv.read-the-whole-thing.name: Read the Whole Thing
achv.read-the-whole-thing.desc: Unlock all 80 lore entries in the codex. Even the one that is mostly about hats.
